### Props

| Name               | Type            | Required | Default       | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------ | --------------- | -------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `nodes`            | `Array<object>` | ✓        | —             | Tree nodes (root level). Each node: `{ id, label, children?, icon?, badge? }`. The keys `id`, `label`, `children` are configurable via the `*Key` props. |
| `expandedIds`      | `union`         |          | `[]`          | Set of currently-expanded node ids. Pass with `.sync` (or `:expanded-ids` + `@update:expanded-ids`) to control expansion state from the parent.          |
| `selectedId`       | `object`        |          | `null`        | Currently-selected node id (or null). Pass with `.sync`.                                                                                                 |
| `idKey`            | `string`        |          | `'id'`        | Override the `id` key on node objects.                                                                                                                   |
| `labelKey`         | `string`        |          | `'label'`     | Override the `label` key.                                                                                                                                |
| `childrenKey`      | `string`        |          | `'children'`  | Override the `children` key.                                                                                                                             |
| `indent`           | `number`        |          | `18`          | Indent per depth (px).                                                                                                                                   |
| `title`            | `string`        |          | `''`          | Optional title rendered above the tree.                                                                                                                  |
| `description`      | `string`        |          | `''`          | Optional description rendered under the title.                                                                                                           |
| `emptyLabel`       | `string`        |          | `'No items.'` | Empty-state text when nodes[] is empty.                                                                                                                  |
| `expandLabel`      | `string`        |          | `'Expand'`    | A11y label for the expand button.                                                                                                                        |
| `collapseLabel`    | `string`        |          | `'Collapse'`  | A11y label for the collapse button.                                                                                                                      |
| `expandAllOnMount` | `boolean`       |          | `false`       | Expand all nodes on mount.                                                                                                                               |
